hero.headline: We don't just assist vulnerability;
hero.subheadline: Transforming Ecuador's future through child protection, technological access to justice, and divergent thinking.
hero.body: In the heart of deep Ecuador, where adversities often challenge our resilience, an ecosystem of changemakers with years of territorial experience was born. We are not a conventional organization; we are a comprehensive social innovation lab.
dna.headline: Divergent Thinking:
dna.headlineAccent: The Architecture of a New Society.
dna.intro: We were founded in 2018 as an essential space for the historically marginalized. Our experience is based on five strategic pillars:
dna.pillars.childhood.title: Comprehensive Child Development
dna.pillars.childhood.text: The first 1,000 days define a nation's future. We design the architecture of cognitive and nutritional development as a foundational social pillar.
dna.pillars.rights.title: Rights Protection & Equity
dna.pillars.rights.text: We guarantee environments of affection and safety, intervening in family crises with a technical focus to ensure dignity and the full restoration of rights.
dna.pillars.tech.title: Digital Justice & Democratization
dna.pillars.tech.text: We eliminate economic barriers to legal access through technological innovation and AI, turning legal defense into a universal right just a click away.
dna.pillars.leadership.title: Youth Leadership & Empowerment
dna.pillars.leadership.text: We transform social risks into artistic expression, community leadership, and technical skills for the construction of sustainable life projects.
dna.pillars.innovation.title: Social Innovation & Systemic Resilience
dna.pillars.innovation.text: A divergent thinking laboratory trained for immediate technical response to social and natural crises, scaling real impact with administrative solvency.
impact.headline: Impact Traceability:
impact.body: Behind every metric, there are names, families, and rescued futures. We have years of rigorous work in the most challenging sectors, ensuring every effort focuses where it is needed most: the human being.
cdi.headline: Real Spaces of
cdi.body: Every captured smile is the result of a commitment that dignifies childhood. Explore the active work within our allied centers.
cdi.centers.gotitas: CDI Gotitas del Saber — San Miguel
cdi.centers.amiguitos: CDI Amiguitos a Jugar — Unida Norte
galleries.innovation.title: Transformative technology
galleries.innovation.body: Development ecosystems where AI and digital training empower our community.
galleries.hiphop.title: Cultural activism
galleries.hiphop.body: We turn street risks into creative energy, art, and active youth leadership.
galleries.children.title: Protecting childhood
galleries.children.body: A gallery of moments reflecting the restitution of rights and the vitality of our childhood.
galleries.workshops.title: Community workshops
galleries.workshops.body: Skill development and participatory learning to empower our local communities.
galleries.reels.title: Stories in Motion
galleries.reels.body: Feel the lingering impact. Immersive testimonies proving solidarity has a face and a voice.
volunteer.headline: Mobilizing
volunteer.body: We don't just seek presence; we seek co-authors of change—creative technologists, specialists, and entrepreneurs ready to multiply the impact. Your talent is the tool that breaks the cycle of poverty.

artivismoBanner.headline: COLOR & VIDA FESTIVAL:
artivismoBanner.body: We inaugurate our national Artivism campaign with an itinerant muralism and graffiti festival touring across Ecuador. In this first edition, we will transform 11 strategic locations across Milagro (Guayas) and La Libertad (Santa Elena), channeling 100% of private sector contributions directly into early childhood nutrition and protection.
artivismoBanner.statMuralsDesc: Inauguration in Guayas and Santa Elena with artist delegations.
artivismoBanner.statTourDesc: Annual itinerant campaign scaling to multiple cities across Ecuador.
artivismoBanner.statSocialDesc: Direct funding for infant nutrition and early stimulation.
artivismoBanner.statTaxDesc: Estimated additional tax deduction subject to MDH/SRI qualification.
primeros1000.heroDesc1: The national muralism and graffiti tour turning urban spaces into educational platforms for social impact. We launch this nationwide movement in Milagro (Guayas) and La Libertad (Santa Elena) around the core cause: «First 1,000 Days: Nutrition and Life».
primeros1000.heroDesc2: 100% of donations, contributions, and funds raised from the private sector go directly to equipment, nutritional supplementation, and CDI prevention for vulnerable infants served by Underlife Foundation.
primeros1000.purposeSubtitle: The window from gestation to age 3 irreversibly shapes neurodevelopment, physical growth, and human cognitive capacity.
primeros1000.cardNeuroText: During this phase, the brain creates over 1 million new neural connections every second. Lack of stimulation and affectionate environments produces irreversible consequences for future learning.
primeros1000.cardDciText: Chronic child malnutrition in coastal peri-urban zones damages immune defenses and biological growth. The social fund finances direct nutritional supplementation and balanced food baskets.
primeros1000.cardMuralText: The festival goes beyond aesthetic art: every mural becomes an open-air classroom educating neighborhood families on breastfeeding, stimulation, hygiene, and children's rights.
primeros1000.imgInfanciaDesc: Early stimulation, nutritional support, and daily care for vulnerable children.
primeros1000.imgArteDesc: Visual community transformation conveying nutrition and human rights messages.
primeros1000.imgArtistasDesc: Collaborative curation alongside Strokes Together collective.
primeros1000.imgTransparenciaDesc: Full accountability of supplies, nutrition kits, and community adaptations.
primeros1000.tourSubtitle: Intensive art and community impact interventions in priority communities of coastal Ecuador, establishing the model for national expansion.
primeros1000.mapDesc: Connecting 11 neighborhood interventions along the Ecuadorian Coast into a national blueprint.
primeros1000.taxDesc: In accordance with Article 10, paragraph 19 of the Internal Tax Regime Law (LRTI) and ministerial regulations (MDH/MIES), qualified projects for early childhood protection and CDI prevention can access an additional tax deduction of up to 150% upon assignment of the corresponding official resolution code.
primeros1000.taxDisclaimerTitle: Projected Incentive under the LRTI (MDH / SRI)
primeros1000.taxDisclaimerText: * Projected incentive in accordance with LRTI. Issuance of the special tax certificate will apply upon formal notification of the qualification code by the competent authority (MDH/SRI). All contributions are backed by the Underlife Foundation regular Institutional Donation Certificate.
primeros1000.taxSimNote: Valid for direct monetary contributions as well as in-kind donations of paint supplies and pro-bono services.
primeros1000.tiersSubtitle: Underlife Foundation operates on 100% self-management and co-responsibility. We welcome diverse contribution channels with full traceability.
primeros1000.tier1Desc: For brands, companies, and associations seeking strategic CSR, mural co-branding, and estimated corporate tax benefits.
primeros1000.tier1F1: Brand visibility on finished pedagogical murals.
primeros1000.tier1F2: Mentions in audiovisual capsules and official livestreams.
primeros1000.tier1F3: Tax deduction certificate (subject to final MDH resolution issuance) / Regular institutional donation certificate.
primeros1000.tier1F4: Technical CSR impact report with infant metrics.
primeros1000.tier2Desc: Direct supply of materials, paint, and logistics reducing operating costs to zero and ensuring funds directly serve infants.
primeros1000.tier2F1: Latex paint, spray cans, brushes, rollers, and scaffolds.
primeros1000.tier2F2: Solidarity accommodation and lodging for artist crews.
primeros1000.tier2F3: Food rations and catering for participating delegations.
primeros1000.tier2F4: Printing, local transportation, or technical gear.
primeros1000.tier3Desc: Individuals, professionals, families, and philanthropists wishing to voluntarily sponsor vulnerable infants or a neighborhood mural.
primeros1000.tier3F2: International online donations via PayPal or Credit Card.
primeros1000.tier3F3: Direct sponsorship of child nutrition and stimulation kits.
primeros1000.tier3F4: Honorable mention in the festival's digital archive.
primeros1000.artistsTitle: Are You a Muralist or Graffiti Artist?
primeros1000.artistsTitleAccent: Pre-register on the Priority Alert List
primeros1000.artistsDesc: Together with Strokes Together collective, we will open the official curatorship for 7-10 artists per location. We provide paints, scaffolding, meals, and lodging during the 2-3 day intervention sessions.
primeros1000.govDesc: 100% of funds raised through this initiative are converted into early childhood stimulation kits, nutrition support, and center adaptations in Milagro and La Libertad. The Project Management Unit (PMU) accounts via community handover acts, curatorship records, and official tax filings.
